title_en: M.D. · Postdoctoral Fellow · Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital · AI4Rad Lab
title_cn: M.D. · 博士后 · 上海市第六人民医院放射介入科 · AI4Rad 实验室
bio_en: Chao Zhu, M.D. (Anhui Medical University), joined the Department of Radiology at Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital as a Postdoctoral Fellow in 2025 and is a member of AI4Rad Lab. His research focuses on emergency abdominal imaging AI, foundation models, and multicenter clinical validation.
bio_cn: 朱超，医学博士（安徽医科大学），2025 年入站上海交通大学医学院附属第六人民医院放射介入科博士后，AI4Rad 实验室成员。主要研究方向包括腹部急诊影像人工智能、基础模型与多中心临床转化验证。
